test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Diligent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Industrious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Diligent"** refers to someone who works hard and shows careful and persistent effort in their tasks. (मेहनती)

 
 
• **Example: **The diligent student completed all his assignments on time and performed exceptionally well in exams.
 
 
 
• **"Industrious" **means hardworking and consistently working with effort and energy. It is synonymous with diligent. (परिश्रमी)
 
 
• **Example: **She is an industrious worker who always meets her deadlines and exceeds expectations.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Industrious" **is the most appropriate synonym for **"Diligent"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Industrious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.

 
 
• **Example:** He is too lazy to clean his room, even after repeated requests from his parents.
 
 
 
• **Noisy **(शोरगुल वाला ): Making a lot of noise or sound.
 
 
• **Example: **The noisy classroom made it difficult for the teacher to focus on her lecture.
 
 
 
• **Positive** (सकारात्मक): Having an optimistic or constructive attitude.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the challenges, she maintained a positive outlook on life.
